model_output: answer to the final user turn
context_policy: Render the complete history with the pinned Omni template. Log and retain over-limit cases, timeouts and truncated answers.
accept: Meaning and applicable context must score 2, every other applicable dimension must score at least 1, and no critical error may occur.
procedure: Use case-specific expected criteria alongside the rubric. Two reviewers score paired responses in randomized order with model identities hidden. A third reviewer resolves disagreements.
report: Keep scores, raw responses, finish reasons, failures, denominators and paired differences by group and task. Use the dev split for checkpoint selection.
